أظطلم (form VIII)
# أَظْطَلِمُ (ʔaẓṭalimu) /ʔaðˤ.tˤa.li.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# أَظْطَلِمَ (ʔaẓṭalima) /ʔaðˤ.tˤa.li.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# أَظْطَلِمْ (ʔaẓṭalim) /ʔaðˤ.tˤa.lim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
